scholarships.name: LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship
scholarships.description: The LIC Golden Jubilee Scholarship is a merit-cum-means scheme launched by the Life Insurance Corporation of India to support students from economically weaker sections (EWS) in continuing their education after Class 10 or 12. It aims to reduce financial barriers and encourage higher education in fields such as Medical, Engineering, General Graduation, Diploma, ITI, and Vocational courses

scholarships.name: HDFC Parivartan ECSS Scholarship
scholarships.description: The HDFC Bank Parivartan ECSS Scholarship 2026 offers financial aid up to ₹75,000 for students from Class 1 to postgraduate studies facing financial difficulties. A student can avail this scholarship for a maximum of 2 consecutive academic year .

scholarships.name: Foundation For Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: Admission through a merit based entrance examination and require 70% or higher marks in 12th
scholarships.description: The Foundation For Excellence (FFE) Scholarship 2026 is designed to assist bright students from low-income families who have excelled in state or national level entrance exams. It is a merit- and need-based program that provides not only financial support but also long-term mentorship and career guidance to help students succeed professionally and academically

scholarships.name: CEETAT Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: No criteria of marks (Generally recommended by staff advisor)

scholarships.name: AICTE Swanath Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: There is no fixed min mark. Selection is based on merit (class 12th marks)
scholarships.description:
The Scheme is being implemented by AICTE to provide encouragement and support to orphans, wards of parents 
died due to Covid-19, wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces martyred in action (Shaheed) to 
pursue education. This is an attempt to give every such child, an opportunity to study further and prepare for a 
successful future through education in AICTE Approved institutions and courses.

scholarships.name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: Differently abled students having disability of not less than 40%.
scholarships.description: Scholarship/Contingency is awarded to Differently abled students taking admission in AICTE approved Technical institution at Degree/ Diploma. Scholarship given @ Rs 50000 as incidentals each year.

scholarships.name: AICTE Pragathi Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: Female students admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) of AICTE-approved institutions
scholarships.description:
Scheme being implemented by AICTE aimed at providing assistance for advancement of 
Girls pursuing technical education. Education is one of the most important means of 
empowering women with the knowledge, skill and self-confidence necessary to participate 
fully in the development process. This is an attempt to give young women the opportunity to 
further her education and prepare for a successful future by “Empowering Women through 
Technical Education”

scholarships.name: Reliance Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: Students with a household income of under Rs. 15 lakh who are enrolled in first year (academic year 2025-26) of their undergraduate studies pursuing any subject stream can apply. The programme will also aim to encourage applications by girls and specially-abled students. Selected scholars will receive a scholarship of up to 2 lakhs over the duration of their degree programme. In addition to the scholarship grant, the Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships will provide scholars an opportunity to be part of a vibrant alumni network and an enabling support system that will create a long-term impact on their lives and career trajectories.

scholarships.name: Siemens Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: 40% in the entrance exam and 60% in class 12
scholarships.description: The Siemens Scholarship Program is a four-year initiative supporting economically disadvantaged first-year engineering students in India with financial aid, mentorship, internships, and industry-aligned training.

scholarships.name: SBI Asha
scholarships.minMarks: 75% for plus two + min CGPA 7.0 for other years
scholarships.description: The SBI Platinum Jubilee Asha Scholarship 2025-26, launched by SBI Foundation, is one of India’s largest scholarship initiatives designed to empower meritorious students from economically weaker backgrounds. The program ensures that financial challenges do not hinder access to quality education, supporting students across multiple levels and disciplines.

scholarships.name: Sitaram Jindal Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Sitaram Jindal Scholarship, administered by the Sitaram Jindal Foundation (SJF) in Bengaluru, is designed to support financially disadvantaged yet meritorious students. It covers students pursuing education from Class 11 up to postgraduate degrees, including ITI, diploma, engineering, medical, and other technical courses. The scholarship is open to students from all categories—General, OBC, SC, ST, and minority communities—and is available for students in government, government-aided, and private institutions that do not charge exorbitant fees .

scholarships.name: Nidhi Kadhir Watson (NKW) Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: First 2000 rank and above 90% in plus two
scholarships.description: Dr. Nidhi Kadir Watson Memorial Scholarship is established by Nidhi Kadir Watson Program, here in after called NKW Program, formed by Nidhi’s parents Kadirpillai Chollampattu and Tara Fatima. The Program is offering scholarships for students in Kerala to pursue studies leading to a Bachelors degree in the fields of engineering/ medicine/technology / computer science / architecture / naval-architecture / arts or general science. Scholarships will be awarded for four years of study in engineering or medicine. For others, depending on duration of the course.

scholarships.name: Pratiksha Trust Anandam Senapathy Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: 80% for Plus 2 examination and a good rank for NEET/KEAM exam
scholarships.description: The Anandam Senapathy Scholarship, instituted by Pratiksha Trust, supports economically underprivileged yet meritorious students from Kerala pursuing MBBS and B.Tech courses. Since its inception, the scholarship has supported over 1,200 students, with 200 current scholars pursuing their dreams of becoming engineers and doctors.

scholarships.name: Vidya Sammunathi Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Vidya Samunnathi Scholarship is a financial assistance program initiated by the Kerala State Welfare Corporation for Forward Communities Ltd (KSWCFC). It is designed to support students from economically backward families within the non-reservation (forward) communities of Kerala to pursue education from high school through postgraduate levels, including professional and national-level institutions.

scholarships.name: Ravi pillai Foundation (Norka Roots) Scholarship
scholarships.description: A prestigious, merit-based scholarship offered by the R.P. Foundation in partnership with NORKA Roots, providing significant financial assistance and long-term academic support to economically disadvantaged students pursuing higher education.

scholarships.name: MACEAA Hope Plus Scholarship
scholarships.description: The MACEAA HOPE Plus Scholarship 2025–26, offered by the MACEA Galaxy Charitable Trust, provides up to ₹40,000 per year to financially challenged but academically strong students of the College of Engineering Trivandrum (MACE). Applications are open for 1st-year B.Tech and B.Arch students

scholarships.name: MACEAA GEMS Scholarship
scholarships.description: The MACEAA GEMS (Growing Engineers’ Monetary Support) Scholarship 2026 is offered by the College of Engineering Trivandrum Alumni Association (MACEAA) to support financially needy but meritorious students. It provides ₹10,000 per year

scholarships.name: Kind Circle Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.description: The Kind Circle Scholarship for Meritorious Students 2026–27 is a private, need-based program supporting students from Class 1 up to postgraduate level in India, offering a minimum of ₹6,000 and more depending on financial need. Applications are open until 31 March 2027.

scholarships.name: ONGC Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.description: The ONGC Scholarship offers ₹48,000 per year (₹4,000 per month) to 2,000 meritorious students from SC, ST, OBC, and General (EWS) categories pursuing Engineering, MBBS, MBA, or Master’s in Geology/Geophysics. Half of the scholarships are reserved for girl students

scholarships.name: Malayalee Engineer's Association (MEA) Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: Scored above 85% marks in Class X and XII examinations                                                  Ranked within the top 7000 in the Govt. of Kerala Engineering Entrance Examination (KEAM Rank).                                                                                                                   National Aptitude Test in Architecture (NATA) score greater than 110 (For B. Arch students)
scholarships.description: The Malayalee Engineers Association (MEA) Scholarship 2026 is a financial aid program funded by Malayalee engineers in Houston, USA. It provides $600 per year (≈₹50,000) for four years to academically strong but financially needy undergraduate engineering students in Kerala.

scholarships.name: Fisheriers E-Grantz Scholarship
scholarships.description: Fisheries e‑Grantz is Kerala’s dedicated scholarship system for the children of registered fishermen, designed to provide post‑matric educational assistance through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). It has evolved from e‑Grantz 3.0 into the upgraded e‑Grantz 4.0, which is mandatory for applications from the 2025‑26 academic year onwards.

scholarships.name: E-Grantz 4.0
scholarships.description: e‑Grantz is Kerala’s unified scholarship portal that provides pre‑matric and post‑matric financial assistance to students belonging to SC, ST, OBC, SBC, EBC, and OEC categories. It has been upgraded to e‑Grantz 4.0, which is Aadhaar‑linked and offers faster, transparent disbursement through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

scholarships.name: Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Federal Bank Hormis Memorial Foundation Scholarship 2026 is one of the most generous CSR scholarships in India, offering 100% tuition fee reimbursement plus device support for first‑year students admitted under merit to professional courses.

scholarships.name: Legrands Scholarship
scholarships.description:
The Legrand Empowering Scholarship Program 2026–27 is a CSR initiative by Group Legrand India that supports meritorious girl students across India pursuing undergraduate degrees in engineering, architecture, science, commerce, and business. It is one of the most inclusive scholarships, offering higher benefits to students from special categories.

!)Open to girl students across India.
Must have secured admission in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., B.B.A., B.Com., or B.Sc. degrees.
Must have passed Class 12 in the academic year 2024–25.
Must have scored 70% or above in both Class 10 and 12.
Annual family income must be less than or equal to ₹5,00,000.

!!) Open to differently-abled girl students, LGBTQ+ students, Covid-affected students, and those with single parents or orphans.
Must have secured admission in B.Tech., B.E., B.Arch., B.B.A., B.Com., or B.Sc. degrees.
Must have passed Class 12 in the academic year 2024–25.
Must have scored at least 60% in both Class 10 and 12. (Relaxation may be given on a case-by-case basis.)
Annual family income must be less than or equal to ₹5,00,000.

scholarships.name: TATA Capital Pankh Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the preceeding academic year
scholarships.description: The Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship 2026–27 is a CSR initiative by Tata Capital Limited to support economically weaker students across India in pursuing higher education. It provides financial assistance ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 per year, depending on the level of study.

scholarships.name: Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: At least 60% marks in the previous academic year
scholarships.description: The Aadhar Kaushal Scholarship 2025–26, run by Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd (AHFL), is a CSR initiative that supports students with physical disabilities pursuing undergraduate courses across India. It provides financial aid between ₹10,000 and ₹50,000, depending on actual college fees, with applications open until 13 January 2026 via the Buddy4Study portal.

scholarships.name: L'oreal India Scholarship
scholarships.minMarks: 85% in class 12 (science stream) for ug students , 60% in UG course for Pg, PhD students
scholarships.description: The L’Oréal India For Young Women in Science Scholarship 2026–27 is a flagship CSR program by L’Oréal India that empowers academically talented but financially challenged young women to pursue higher education in science. It has been running since 2003 and has supported over 500 scholars across India.

scholarships.name: Swami Dayanand India Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Swami Dayanand India Scholarship 2026–27 provides up to ₹50,000 per year to academically brilliant but financially underprivileged students pursuing professional degrees in engineering, medicine, pharmacy, IT, and architecture in India. Applications are open only to first‑year students admitted under merit quota, with 30% of awards reserved for girls.

scholarships.name: U-GO Scholarship
scholarships.description: The U-Go Scholarship is a financial grant program designed to empower young women from low-income backgrounds pursuing professional undergraduate degrees. Selected scholars receive between INR 40,000 and INR 60,000 per year to cover tuition, books, hostel fees, and living expenses.

scholarships.name: DXC Progressing Mind Scholarship
scholarships.description: The DXC Progressing Minds Scholarship 2026–27 offers a one‑time grant of ₹50,000 to women and transgender students pursuing STEM undergraduate courses in India, with preference given to students with disabilities. Applications are open nationwide via Buddy4Study, with eligibility requiring ≥60% marks and annual family income ≤ ₹4 lakh.

scholarships.name: Amazon Future Engineer's Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Amazon Future Engineer (AFE) Scholarship 2026–27 is a flagship CSR initiative by Amazon India to support first‑year girl engineering students from economically weaker backgrounds. It combines financial aid with mentorship and internship opportunities, making it one of the most holistic scholarships for tech aspirants.

scholarships.name: Kotak Kanya Scholarship
scholarships.description:
Kotak Kanya Scholarship is a collaborative CSR Project of Kotak Mahindra Group companies and Kotak Education Foundation to promote education and livelihood among economically disadvantaged sections of society. This scholarship aims to offer financial assistance to meritorious girl students from low-income families to empower them to pursue higher studies in professional education after Class 12.
Under Kotak Kanya Scholarship 2025, girl students who have passed Class 12 and aspire to pursue professional graduation courses like Engineering, MBBS, Integrated LLB (5 Years), Integrated BS-MS/BS-Research, in ISER, IISC(Bangalore), or other professional courses (Design, Architecture, etc.) from institutes of repute (NAAC/NIRF accredited) will be provided scholarship of INR 1.5 lakh* per year to pay their educational expenses until graduation (degree)

scholarships.name: Infosys Stem Star Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Infosys Foundation STEM Stars Scholarship supports female Indian students pursuing undergraduate STEM degrees, offering up to ₹1 lakh annually to cover tuition, living expenses, and study materials. It is available to first-year students and select second-year/integrated degree students at reputed, NIRF-accredited institutions.

scholarships.name: Priyadarshini Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Priyadarshni Academy Scholarship 2026 is a merit‑cum‑need based program that supports bright students in India pursuing professional and academic degrees such as Engineering, Medicine, IT, Architecture, Management, Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, and B.Ed. The last date to apply is 31 December 2025, and applicants must have completed their first year with distinction and family income below ₹4 lakh per annum.

scholarships.name: Virtusa Engineering Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Virtusa Engineering Excellence Scholarship is a CSR initiative by the Virtusa Foundation that provides a one-time financial grant of INR 50,000 to outstanding, economically disadvantaged students pursuing B.Tech or B.E. degrees across India.

scholarships.name: North South Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.description: The North South Foundation (NSF) Scholarship 2026 in India provides annual financial aid to meritorious but economically disadvantaged students pursuing professional undergraduate courses such as Engineering, Medicine, Agriculture, Nursing, Pharmacy, and Polytechnic. Awards range from ₹45,000 to ₹1.5 lakh depending on the course, and support continues until graduation if academic performance is maintained.

scholarships.name: STOCKGRO Big Dream Scholarship

courses.description: Data is a collection of discrete or continuous values that conveys information, describing the quantity, quality, fact, statistics, other basic units of meaning, or simply sequences of symbols that may be further interpreted formally. A data point or datum is an individual value in a collection of data. Data is usually organized into structures such as tables that provide additional context and meaning, and may itself be used as data in larger structures. Data may be used as variables in a computational process. Data may represent abstract ideas or concrete measurements. Data is commonly used in scientific research, economics, and virtually every other form of human organizational activity.

The field takes inspiration from biological neuroscience and revolves around stacking artificial neurons into layers and "training" them to process data. The adjective "deep" refers to the use of multiple layers in the network. Methods used can be supervised, semi-supervised or unsupervised. Some common deep learning network architectures include fully connected networks, deep belief networks, recurrent neural networks, convolutional neural networks, generative adversarial networks, transformers, and neural radiance fields. These architectures have been applied to fields including computer vision, speech recognition, natural language processing, machine translation, bioinformatics, drug design, medical image analysis, climate science, material inspection and board game programs, where they have produced results comparable to and in some cases surpassing human expert performance.

courses.title: Getting Started with Generative AI (Earn a digital credential!)
courses.description:
Are you interested in learning about generative artificial intelligence? In Foundations in Generative AI, you’ll be introduced to foundational concepts of generative AI, focusing on how machines create content such as text and images. You’ll gain a basic understanding of generative AI through examples and clear explanations. In Ethical Considerations for Generative AI, you’ll explore the ethics of generative AI, including transparency, accountability, and fairness. You explore risks in inputs and outputs of generative AI. You’ll learn about the IBM AI Risk Atlas as a resource for understanding potential impacts. A Large Language Model (LLM) is a type of AI model designed to understand and generate human-like language. LLMs are a foundational technology behind many generative AI applications. In Introduction to Large Language Models, you’ll explore how to apply large language models in practical scenarios such as customer service and content creation, with a focus on guiding IBM Granite models effectively.

 

Complete the following modules to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Getting Started with Generative AI:

1.    Foundations in Generative AI

2.    Ethical Considerations for Generative AI

3.   Introduction to Large Language Models

 

What you’ll learn

After completing these modules, you should be able to:

  • Apply prompt refinement techniques to improve the quality of AI-generated responses
  • Explore the IBM AI risk atlas
  • Craft a product blog post with IBM Granite


Language: English

courses.title: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals (Earn a credential!)
courses.description:
Does artificial intelligence (AI) spark your interest? Here’s your chance to visualize yourself in an AI career! You’ll explore AI’s history, then see how it can change the world. Along the way, you’ll deep dive into ways that AI makes predictions, understands language and images, and learns using circuits inspired by the human brain. After a hands-on simulation in which you build and test a machine learning model, you’ll finish with tips on how to find your own career in artificial intelligence. 

  

Complete the following required courses to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals: 

  1. Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
  2. Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision
  3. Machine Learning and Deep Learning
  4. Run AI Models with IBM Watson Studio
  5. AI Ethics
  6. Your Future in AI: The Job Landscape

  

What you’ll learn 

After completing Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals, you should be able to:

  • Describe the history of AI development
  • Define and describe structured, unstructured, and semi-structured data, machine learning, and ways that AI makes predictions from data
  • Explain how AI understands human language
  • Explain how AI analyzes and creates images
  • Describe three ways that AI analyzes data
  • Describe how AI makes predictions using neural networks
  • Explain generative AI and the impact in today's world
  • Create an AI machine learning model using IBM Watson Studio
  • Describe ways that AI systems can be designed to minimize bias
  • Recognize the AI job market, responsibilities and skill sets of an AI professional, hand resources and learning opportunities to explore

  

The knowledge and skills in these courses build on each other, so SkillsBuild recommends that you complete the courses in the order in which they are presented.

courses.title: AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI (Earn a digital credential!)
courses.description:
From personalized shopping recommendations to advanced medical imaging, artificial intelligence (AI) is driving innovation across industries and transforming the way you live, learn, and work. AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI is your introduction to the core concepts and technologies of AI. 

 

In five engaging modules, you’ll explore what AI is, how machines and humans learn differently, and how machine learning, neural networks, and deep learning drive today’s AI applications. You’ll discover real-world examples of AI in action, practice applying models to solve problems, and reflect on the ethical considerations of using AI responsibly. Whether you’re a student, professional, or lifelong learner, this course equips you with the knowledge and skills to understand, explain, and apply AI in meaningful ways. 

 

Complete the following required modules to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI:   

  1. Introduction to Artificial Intelligence 
  2. The Intelligence Behind AI 
  3. Machine Learning 
  4. Neural Networks and Deep Learning 
  5. AI Forms and Functions 

 

What you’ll learn 

After completing AI Fundamentals: Foundations for Understanding AI, you should be able to:  

  • Describe the foundations of artificial intelligence, including its forms, eras of data processing, and data types 
  • Differentiate human and machine intelligence by recognizing learning processes, machine capabilities, and applications of AI 
  • Apply machine learning principles by using classical models, identifying learning types, and considering their impact on AI accuracy and outputs 
  • Explain how neural networks and deep learning function, including their learning processes, limitations, and issues of fairness and bias 
  • Identify different forms of AI, including predictive, decision-making, computer vision, and generative AI, and their appropriate applications

courses.description: This course focuses intensely on the "muscle and bones" of robotics. It deals with dynamic modeling (Euler-Lagrange formulations) which tells you exactly how much torque a motor needs to lift a heavy robotic link. Understanding this gives you a massive edge in mechanical design and R&D roles

courses.title: CMOS Digital VLSI Design (NPTEL/SWAYAM)
courses.description: This is a flagship course that covers everything from basic MOSFET physics to the design of complex digital systems.It connects circuit-level understanding with system-level design, which is essential for core roles.

courses.title: Introduction to Battery-Management Systems (Coursera - University of Colorado Boulder)
courses.description: This is arguably the best starting point for a student. It provides a firm foundation in lithium-ion cell terminology, how cells fail, and the critical design requirements for a robust BMS.It covers the essential sensing, high-voltage control, and safety aspects.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Electric Vehicles: Technology & Economics (NPTEL)
courses.description: A systems-level view of the EV drivetrain, covering everything from motor selection (BLDC, PMSM) to the economics of transitioning from ICE vehicles to electric in the Indian context.

courses.title: Electric Vehicles and Renewable Energy (NPTEL)
courses.description: A comprehensive systems-level course covering EV architecture, battery pack design, motor controllers, and charging infrastructure, specifically tailored to the Indian power scenario

courses.title: MATLAB and Simulink for EV Design (Intellipaat/IIT Roorkee)
courses.description: A professional-grade course that teaches you to model and simulate battery performance, motor control algorithms, and charging cycles using MATLAB/Simulink—the gold standard in the automotive industry.

courses.title: NOC: Renewable Energy Sources: Fundamentals and Technologies (NPTEL)
courses.description: A deep dive into the scientific and engineering principles behind solar PV, wind energy, biomass, and hybrid power systems, with a strong focus on the Indian power scenario.

courses.title: Renewable Energy & Power Evacuation Specialization (Coursera)
courses.description: This specialization is excellent because it covers "Power Evacuation," which is a critical, often overlooked topic in core engineering. It deals with how you actually connect a massive solar or wind farm to the existing national grid without causing instabilities.

courses.title: Power Electronics for Renewable Energy Systems (NPTEL/Swayam)
courses.description: Focuses entirely on the Power Electronics side: DC-DC converters for MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking), inverters for grid synchronization, and harmonic mitigation.

courses.title: Smart Grid: Basics to Advanced Technologies (NPTEL/Swayam)
courses.description: Covers the full spectrum from Wide Area Monitoring Systems (WAMS) and Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) to Microgrid control, demand-side management, and smart grid protection.

courses.title: A Practitioner’s Approach to Power Distribution & Automation (Coursera - L&T EduTech)
courses.description: Focuses on the practical implementation of smart meters, automated distribution systems, and the actual communication protocols used in modern utility-grade electrical infrastructure.

courses.title: Automation and PLC (NPTEL)
courses.description: NPTEL offers excellent courses that cover the fundamental logic behind industrial automation. These courses are highly valued because they teach the underlying theory of ladder logic and industrial control systems used in large-scale plants.This course covers the basics of PLC, relay logic, sensors, actuators, and how to design automated control sequences.

courses.title: SCADA Systems and Industrial Communication (Coursera / Professional Certification)
courses.description: Focuses on HMI (Human Machine Interface) design, data acquisition, alarm management, and the protocols (like Modbus, Profibus, and OPC-UA) that allow different machines to talk to each other.

courses.title: Construction Management (Columbia Univ.)
courses.description: Master the lifecycle of construction projects, from budgeting and bidding to scheduling and risk management.

courses.title: Concrete Technology (NPTEL)
courses.description: A deep dive into material science, mix design, and durability, which is fundamental for any site engineer.

courses.title: Repair and Maintenance of Buildings
courses.description: Very practical; covers structural defects, diagnosis, and rehabilitation—high demand in industry.

courses.title: Excel Skills for Business (Macquarie University)
courses.description: The most requested skill in entry-level hiring. Covers everything from data organization to advanced analysis.

courses.title: Prompt Engineering for ChatGPT
courses.description: Learn how to use Generative AI to speed up study, writing reports, and automating mundane tasks.

courses.title: Google Digital Garage: Fundamentals of Digital Marketing
courses.description: Even if you aren't in marketing, "Digital Literacy" in the modern world means understanding how search engines work, how data impacts visibility, and how to build a professional online presence. This is an industry-recognized certificate.

courses.title: Cisco Networking Academy: Cybersecurity Essentials
courses.description: Every engineer (regardless of branch) should understand the basics of protecting their digital assets. This is the gold standard for foundational cybersecurity knowledge.

courses.title: Data Literacy (Earn a digital credential!)
courses.description:
From fitness trackers and streaming apps to business reports and online shopping, data shapes the decisions people make every day. Data Literacy is your practical introduction to understanding and using data in clear and meaningful ways. In two engaging modules, you’ll explore what data is, where it comes from, how it’s organized and analyzed, and how it helps people and organizations make better decisions. You’ll learn to recognize different types of data, understand data tools, interpret charts and dashboards, and identify data quality and ethical considerations of data use. Whether you’re a student, job seeker, or working professional, this course builds a foundation, helping you read, question, and use data confidently in real-world situations.

 

Complete the following modules to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Data Literacy:

  1. Exploring Data
  2. Sensemaking with Data

 

What you’ll learn

After completing Data Literacy, you should be able to:

  • Define data
  • Determine the benefits of data
  • Classify data based on nature, mode of collection, and structure
  • Determine the steps the database management system (DBMS) uses to process a structured query language (SQL) query
  • Identify the activities in the five-step data analysis process
  • Describe how data informs personal and workplace decisions
  • Categorize common data tools by purpose
  • Identify data visualization types given a scenario
  • Identify data quality and ethical implications of data

 

Audience: Data Literacy is appropriate for everyone: students, working professionals, job seekers, and anyone looking to expand their skills or transition into data-related roles.

 

The knowledge and skills in these modules build on each other, so IBM SkillsBuild recommends that you complete the modules in the order in which they are presented.

courses.title: Digital Literacy (Earn a credential!)
courses.description:
Individuals need skills to live, learn, and work in a society where communication and access to information is increasing through digital technologies like internet platforms, social media, and mobile devices. Being digitally literate gives you power to identify and use digital technologies safely and efficiently, equips you with correct data, and enables you to achieve success in academic and professional spaces.

 

Complete the following required modules to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Digital Literacy:

  • Introduction to Digital Literacy
  • Basic Computer Skills
  • Navigating the Internet
  • Digital Communications and Collaboration
  • Managing Projects in a Digital Environment
  • Online Security
  • Digital Data Gathering, Analysis and Presentation
  • Software Engineering and Coding
  • Applying Artificial Intelligence
  • Digital Literacy and Accessing Future Careers

 

What you’ll learn

After completing the Digital Literacy course, you should be able to:

  • Define digital literacy and identify the importance of being digitally literate for personal and professional growth
  • Identify the basic tools used in digital devices and how to use a web browser
  • Describe digital processes and tools to communicate, collaborate, and manage projects
  • Apply strategies to ensure your online security and define data gathering processes
  • Define AI and describe the best practices for using AI tools

 

The knowledge and skills in these modules build on each other, so SkillsBuild recommends that you complete the modules in the order in which they are presented.

courses.title: Information Technology Fundamentals (Earn a credential!)
courses.description:
Are you ready to find out about the world of information technology (IT)? Learn about the history of computing and essential concepts about computer parts, network connections, hardware, software, computer security, and troubleshooting techniques. Then get hands-on practice troubleshooting a customer’s network issue, in a series of simulations, with a remote connectivity tool. Finish by gathering tips and resources that can help you launch a great career in IT support. 

  

Complete the following required courses to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Information Technology Fundamentals:

  1. Computer Basics
  2. Computer Networking Basics: How Computers Communicate
  3. Computing from Past to Present
  4. Security Basics
  5. Support Basics
  6. Troubleshooting for Hardware, Networks, and Software
  7. Support a Customer with a Network Issue
  8. Your Future in IT Support: The Job Landscape

  

What you’ll learn 

After completing Information Technology Fundamentals, you should be able to:

  • Identify computer basics, including the parts of a computer, the differences between local and cloud computing, and the importance of user identity and security on computer systems
  • Identify personal, local, and wide-area networks, network security, network addresses, and network communications
  • Identify milestones in the history of computing, the developments that allowed computers to become multifunctional, and hardware and software support for usability, accessibility, and security
  • Recognize common ways to make computer hardware and software secure and ways IT professionals can protect users and systems from common security threats
  • Describe troubleshooting and a basic troubleshooting methodology
  • Explain techniques for troubleshooting and debugging hardware, networking, and software issues
  • Collect information about a customer’s issue to form a theory, troubleshoot, and fix a network issue using a remote connectivity tool
  • Recognize the job market, responsibilities and skill sets of IT support professionals, and resources and learning opportunities to explore

  

The knowledge and skills in these courses build on each other, so SkillsBuild recommends that you complete the courses in the order in which they are presented.

courses.title: SOLIDWORKS 3D CAD for Education Specialization
courses.description: SOLIDWORKS is an absolute industry-standard software for CAD modeling. This five-course specialization takes you from a blank canvas to building complex mechanical assemblies. You'll master sketching, 3D modeling, adding materials, and assembling parts with mechanical mates—culminating in a hands-on capstone design challenge.

courses.title: NPTEL - MATLAB Programming
courses.description: Conducted by IIT Madras, this course is the ultimate guide to mastering computational engineering. Instead of just treating MATLAB as a basic calculator, you will learn how to write actual code to solve real-world engineering problems, manage data matrices, perform numerical integrations, and automate complex equations.

courses.title: Computer Aided Engineering Design
courses.description: Offered by IIT Kanpur, this course bridges the gap between raw mathematics and computer graphics. You will dive under the hood of CAD software to understand how geometric curves (like Bezier and B-Splines), surfaces, and solid 3D models are mathematically generated. It's an essential conceptual tool for anyone wanting to work in advanced R&D.

courses.title: Product Design and Manufacturing
courses.description: This stellar NPTEL course (supported by organizations like ISRO, HAL, and SAIL) teaches you how to design products so they can actually be built efficiently in a real factory. You will master critical engineering tools such as DFMA (Design for Manufacturing and Assembly), rapid prototyping, reverse engineering, and lifecycle cost estimation.

courses.title: Fundamentals of Sustainability and Technology (Earn a credential!)
courses.description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to build skills for jobs in the green economy and contribute to a more sustainable future? The world increasingly recognizes the need for environmentally friendly practices in all areas of life, and this learning plan can help you acquire the skills and knowledge needed to make a meaningful impact. 

  

By enrolling in this learning plan, you’ll have the chance to learn about sustainability science and its applications in various fields of technology. Not only will you gain knowledge about sustainability, but you’ll also develop practical skills to make a difference in various industries such as renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, green building, and waste management. You’ll learn to define sustainability, identify ways that sustainability updates and extends the concept of conservation, and describe key applications of artificial intelligence and data analytics to drive sustainability. 

  

By completing these courses, you’ll earn an industry recognized SkillsBuild credential in Fundamentals of Sustainability and Technology. This credential can help you stand out to potential employers and demonstrate your commitment to sustainability. 

  

After completing the courses required for the Fundamentals of Sustainability and Technology credential, you should be able to:

  • Define sustainability
  • Identify ways that sustainability updates and extends the concept of conservation
  • Define the environmental, social, and governance (ESG) pillars that help guide sustainability initiatives
  • Explain how data analytics helps organizations identify and measure sustainability issues and guide their solutions
  • Describe key sustainability applications of artificial intelligence and hybrid cloud
  • Describe new or rapidly changing technologies that can impact sustainability issues
  • Make decisions in the role of a sustainability scientist
  • Identify with the personal experience of researchers working on sustainability initiatives

courses.title: Business English Communication
courses.description: Crack your placement interviews and Group Discussions (GD) with ease. Run via SWAYAM/NPTEL, this course empowers engineering students to write persuasive proposals, deliver high-impact presentations, and master workplace etiquette for the modern post-AI global business economy.

courses.title: Creative Thinking: Techniques and Tools for Success
courses.description: Delivered by Imperial College London, this course provides a mental toolkit for out-of-the-box engineering. You will learn systematic problem-solving frameworks like TRIZ (Theory of Inventive Problem Solving), SCAMPER, and morphological analysis to break patterns and approach design or process bottlenecks with innovative solutions.

courses.title: Design Thinking for Innovation
courses.description: Innovation isn't just magic—it’s a process. Offered by the University of Virginia, this course teaches you how to look at complex engineering and industrial problems through a human-centered lens.You will learn how to use practical templates to ask the four key questions of innovation (What is? What if? What wows? and What works?) to prototype creative solutions.

courses.title: NPTEL - Patent Law for Engineers and Scientists
courses.description: Designed by IIT Madras, this course is an absolute game-changer for core engineering students. It teaches you the legal landscape of technology—from understanding patentability criteria to reading, interpreting, and drafting patent specifications. It is highly valued by R&D departments and even prepares you for the Indian Patent Agent Examination.

courses.title: Career Management Essentials (Earn a digital credential!)
courses.description:
Are you struggling to create an impactful resume and find a job role that matches your skills and abilities? Do you wonder if the values of the company you want to work for align with yours? If so, this is the course for you! Learn about researching workplaces, creating a resume that’ll get you noticed, and using AI tools to enhance and tailor your resume for different job roles. Discover how to use professional social networks to create a profile, bypass application tracking systems to reach the human recruiters who do the hiring, and ace the interview process!

 

Complete the following required modules to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Career Management Essentials:

  1. Focus Your Direction with Workplace Research
  2. Develop Your Professional Network and Brand
  3. Create a Great Professional Resume
  4. Ace Your Professional Interview

 

What you’ll learn

After completing Career Management Essentials, you should be able to:

  • Identify workplaces that align with your values and job roles that match your skills and experience
  • Describe how to use professional social networks to create a work brand
  • Identify how to create an effective resume and use AI tools to enhance it
  • Explain how to answer interview questions to increase your chances of getting hired

courses.title: Customer Engagement Fundamentals (Earn a digital credential!)
courses.description:
One of the hottest job areas in high demand is in IT customer service and support. Customer engagement specialists (also known as customer support agents or customer service representatives) are primary points of contact for customers. These service professionals ensure customers are satisfied, even delighted, with the experiences and interactions that they have through customer service channels. 

 

If you’re intrigued by the field of customer engagement, this course is for you. Learn the skills to build relationships with customers, help them solve stressful problems, and win their loyalty. In this course, you’ll discover strategies to build rapport with customers, develop communication skills to troubleshoot issues and guide customers through solutions, use scientific methods to solve problems creatively, and become a productive team member.

 

Complete the following required modules to earn an industry-recognized IBM SkillsBuild digital credential called Customer Engagement Fundamentals:

  1. Practicing Customer-Focused Communication
  2. Cultivating a Service Mindset
  3. Exploring Solution-Driven Behaviors
  4. Developing Productivity Habits

 

What you’ll learn

After completing Customer Engagement Fundamentals, you should be able to:

  • Explain guidelines to conduct respectful and productive discussions with customers
  • Describe personality traits that facilitate a service-oriented mindset
  • Explain troubleshooting and problem-solving methodologies
  • Describe techniques to adhere to organization process and service standards

courses.title: Google Project Management Professional Certificate
courses.description: Designed by Google, this course turns you into an organized powerhouse. It teaches you how to run projects efficiently from start to finish, manage team dynamics, handle risks, and master Agile/Scrum frameworks—skills that are highly sought after by recruiters during core engineering and management consulting placements.

courses.title: Operations and Supply Chain Management
courses.description: Offered by IIT Madras, this course is crucial for anyone entering industrial engineering, manufacturing, or logistics. You will learn the science behind planning and operational decisions, how to streamline factory workflows, optimize inventory, and coordinate supply chain logistics to minimize waste and maximize business efficiency.

courses.title: Supply Chain Logistics
courses.description: Offered by Rutgers University, this course focuses on the physical movement of goods. You will explore the three pillars of logistics: transportation (rail, road, air, ocean), warehousing (inventory storage and facility design), and network planning. It's a great course to understand how global products get from raw material suppliers to customer doors.

courses.title: Six Sigma Principles
courses.description: Offered by the University System of Georgia, this course introduces you to the global gold standard of process improvement: Six Sigma. You will learn the legendary DMAIC framework (Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) and quality control tools to eliminate defects and variations in any engineering process.

softwares.name: KiCad
softwares.description: KiCad – KiCad is a free software suite for electronic design automation . It facilitates the design and simulation of electronic hardware for PCB manufacturing. It features an integrated environment for schematic capture, PCB layout, manufacturing file viewing, ngspice-provided SPICE simulation, and engineering calculation. Tools exist within the package to create bill of materials, artwork, Gerber files, and 3D models of the PCB and its components. == History == === Early history === KiCad was created in 1992 by Jean-Pierre Charras while working at IUT de Grenoble. The name came from the first letters in the name of a company of Jean-Pierre's friend in combination with the term CAD. KiCad originally was a collection of electronics programs intended to be used in conjunction with each other.

EasyEDA – EasyEDA is a web-based electronic design automation tool suite that enables hardware engineers to design, simulate, share and discuss schematics, simulations and printed circuit boards, and to create a bill of materials, Gerber files, pick and place files and documentary outputs in the file formats PDF, PNG, and SVG. EasyEDA allows creating and editing schematic diagrams, SPICE simulation of mixed analogue and digital circuits and creating and editing printed circuit board layouts, and optionally, manufacturing printed circuit boards. Subscription-free membership is available for public projects plus a limited number of private projects. The number of private projects can be increased by contributing high quality public projects, schematic symbols, and printed circuit board footprints and/or by paying a monthly fee. Registered users can download Gerber files from the tool free of charge; but for a fee, EasyEDA offers a PCB fabrication service. This service is also able to accept Gerber file inputs from third-party tools. EasyEDA is a division of JLCPCB. == History == In June 2010, Dillon He and Eric Cui started a survey of EDA tools for a hardware project of their own.

Key Capabilities

  • Schematic capture and circuit diagram creation
  • Automated PCB routing and multilayer layout design
  • Component library management and 3D board visualization
  • Gerber file generation for manufacturing

Primary Applications

  • Designing printed circuit boards for electronics
  • Prototyping custom embedded systems
  • Hardware testing and validation

Founded as Protel Systems in 1985, it provides electronic design automation software to engineers for designing printed circuit boards. Its products are designed for use in a Microsoft Windows environment and used in industries such as automotive, aerospace, defence and telecommunications. Its flagship solutions are Altium Discover, Altium Develop, and Altium Agile, each of which is built on the unified electronics design software Altium Designer, and Altium 365, a cloud platform that connects stakeholders and centralises data. Altium became a subsidiary of Renesas Electronics in 2024. == History == === 1985–1991: Early history === The history of Altium dates to 1985 with the founding of Protel Systems Pty Ltd by electronics designer Nicholas Martin.

Rhinoceros geometry is based on the non-uniform rational B-spline mathematical model, which focuses on producing mathematically precise representation of curves and freeform surfaces in computer graphics . Rhinoceros is used for computer-aided design , computer-aided manufacturing , rapid prototyping, 3D printing and reverse engineering in industries including architecture, industrial design , product design as well as for multimedia and graphic design. Rhinoceros is developed for Microsoft Windows and macOS. A visual scripting language add-on for Rhino, Grasshopper, is developed by Robert McNeel & Associates. == Overview == === Characteristics === Rhinoceros is primarily a freeform surface modeler that uses the NURBS mathematical model. softwares.name: Onshape
softwares.description: Onshape – Onshape is a computer-aided design software system, delivered over the Internet via a software as a service model. It makes extensive use of cloud computing, with compute-intensive processing and rendering performed on Internet-based servers, and users are able to interact with the system via a web browser or the iOS and Android apps. As a SaaS system, Onshape upgrades are released directly to the web interface, and the software does not require maintenance by the user. Onshape allows teams to collaborate on a single shared design, the same way multiple writers can work together editing a shared document via cloud services. It is primarily focused on mechanical CAD and is used for product and machinery design across many industries, including consumer electronics, mechanical machinery, medical devices, 3D printing, machine parts, and industrial equipment. As of 2025, Onshape is popularly used as a CAD suite for the FIRST Robotics Competition alongside the FRCDesignApp application available in the Onshape App Store.

entrance_exams.name: GATE( Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering)
entrance_exams.description: GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) is a prestigious national-level examination in India that evaluates comprehensive understanding of various undergraduate subjects in engineering and science. For B.Tech students, it acts as a primary gateway to pursue postgraduate studies (M.Tech/Ph.D) with stipends and secure entry-level jobs in public sector undertakings (PSUs).
entrance_exams.categories: Admissions to top institutes like IITs/NITs and entry-level recruitment at PSUs (e.g., ONGC, IOCL).
entrance_exams.eligibleYears: B.Tech students in their 3rd year or higher, as well as recent graduates, are eligible to apply. There are no upper age limit restrictions and  you can attempt the exam as many times as you want.

entrance_exams.name: CAT (Common Admission Test)
entrance_exams.description: Entrance examination for admission to MBA and other management programs.Accepted by Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) and many other top business schools across India.
entrance_exams.categories: Career Opportunities include Management Consultant, Marketing Manager, Financial Analyst, Product Manager, Operations Manager, Business Analyst, Entrepreneur, and various leadership roles in corporate organizations.
entrance_exams.eligibleYears: Candidates must have a bachelor's degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks (45% for SC/ST/PwD candidates), and final-year students are also eligible to apply

entrance_exams.name: ESE ( Engineering Services Examination)
entrance_exams.description: Conducted by Union Public Service Commission for services such as Indian Railways, Central Public Works Department, Central Water Commission, and other central engineering departments.
entrance_exams.categories: Group A and Group B engineering officer posts, including roles such as Executive Engineer, Assistant Executive Engineer, and other technical officer positions in government departments.

entrance_exams.name: UPSC Civil Services Examination(CSE)
entrance_exams.description: Recruitment to top Administrative Services of India.

entrance_exams.name: GRE ( Graduate Record Examination)
entrance_exams.categories: Universities in USA, Canada, Europe etc
entrance_exams.eligibleYears: Open to graduates and Final year students.

entrance_exams.name: AFCAT (Air Force Common Admission Test)
entrance_exams.description: Entry into Indian Air Force officer cadre
entrance_exams.categories: Air Force (IAF) to recruit Class-I Gazetted Officers for Flying and Ground Duty (Technical and Non-Technical) branches
entrance_exams.eligibleYears: Flying Branch: 20 to 24 years (relaxable up to 26 years for valid Commercial Pilot License holders). Ground Duty: 20 to 26 years

entrance_exams.name: DRDO CEPTAM
entrance_exams.description: Recruitment into defence research and development.
entrance_exams.categories: Scientist , Research Engineer , Defence technology specialist
entrance_exams.eligibleYears: Grduates only( degree must be completed)

entrance_exams.name: IIIT PGEE ( Post Graduate Entrance Examination)
entrance_exams.description: Entrance exam for admission into M.Tech, M.S (Research), and Ph.D programs mainly at institutes like International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad (and some other IIITs depending on program)

entrance_exams.name: SSC JE (Staff Selection Commission Junior Engineer)
entrance_exams.description: The SSC JE (Staff Selection Commission Junior Engineer) exam is a highly competitive national-level test for recruiting Diploma and Degree holders as Junior Engineers in Group B (Non-Gazetted) posts for various central government departments like CPWD, MES, and BRO

entrance_exams.name: VITMEE (VIT Master's Entrance Examination)
entrance_exams.description: Cmputer-based test for admission to postgraduate programs like M.Tech, MCA, and M.Sc across VIT campuses.

entrance_exams.name: CDS (The Combined Defence Services)
entrance_exams.description:
The Combined Defence Services (CDS) exam is a national-level test conducted by the UPSC twice a year for recruitment into the Indian Military Academy, Naval Academy, Air Force Academy, and Officers Training Academy.
Generallly between 19 to 24/25 years.

entrance_exams.name: INET (Indian Navy Entrance Test)
entrance_exams.description:
A national-level computer-based exam used to recruit unmarried male and female candidates for Permanent Commission (PC) and Short Service Commission (SSC) officer roles.
Generally between 18 to 24 years (age requirements vary slightly based on the specific branch).

entrance_exams.name: Scientist/Engineer 'SC' exam
entrance_exams.description: The ISRO entrance exam for Scientist/Engineer 'SC' is conducted by the ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board (ICRB)

entrance_exams.name: PSC (State Public Service Commission Exam)
entrance_exams.description:
State Public Service Commission (PSC) exams are competitive exams conducted by individual Indian states (like the Kerala Public Service Commission, TNPSC, or MPSC) to recruit personnel for Group A and B administrative roles.
Age between 19 to 42.

entrance_exams.name: XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test)
entrance_exams.description: The Xavier Aptitude Test (XAT) is a premier national-level MBA entrance exam conducted by XLRI Jamshedpur

entrance_exams.name: CEED (Common Entrance Examination)
entrance_exams.description: The Common Entrance Examination for Design (CEED) is a national-level aptitude test administered by IIT Bombay for admission to Master of Design (M.Des) and Ph.D. programs at premier institutes across India.

entrance_exams.name: MAT (The Management Aptitude Test)
entrance_exams.description: The Management Aptitude Test (MAT) is a national-level entrance exam conducted by AIMA in India for admissions into MBA and allied programs.

entrance_exams.name: CMAT (The Common Management Admission Test)
entrance_exams.description: The Common Management Admission Test (CMAT) is a national-level computer-based entrance exam conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA) for admission to MBA/PGDM programs in over 1,000 AICTE-approved B-schools across India.
